scripts.dev: npm run build -w @overlook/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @overlook/api" "npm run dev -w @overlook/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @overlook/shared && npm run build -w @overlook/api && npm run build -w @overlook/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @overlook/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run dist -w @overlook/desktop
scripts.test: npm run build -w @overlook/shared && npm test -w @overlook/api && npm run test:e2e -w @overlook/api
